title: Cartwise+ Membership Plan Fee Schedule
content:
Each Cartwise+ Membership plan charges one period fee per paid period. The period fee, the billing cycle and the length of one paid period are fixed per plan as follows, in US dollars.

| Plan | Billing cycle | Period fee (USD) | Length of one paid period |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | monthly | 4.49 | 1 calendar month |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | monthly | 4.99 | 1 calendar month |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | monthly | 9.99 | 1 calendar month |
| Cartwise+ Annual | annual | 99.00 | 12 calendar months |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | annual | 119.00 | 12 calendar months |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | annual | 179.00 | 12 calendar months |

## Renewal date anchoring

All six plans anchor the renewal date the same way: the renewal date falls on the same day of the month as the period start, and where that day does not exist in the renewal month, it falls back to the last day of that shorter month.

| Period starts on (hypothetical) | Plan length | Renewal date |
|---|---|---|
| 12 March | 1 month | 12 April |
| 31 January, non-leap year | 1 month | 28 February (31 February does not exist) |
| 30 August | 1 month | 30 September |
| 29 February | 12 months | 28 February of the following year |

## Reading the schedule

- The period fee is the amount of one charge for one whole paid period, whether that charge is the first period, a renewal or a retry of a declined renewal.
- A monthly plan's fee covers one calendar month; an annual plan's fee covers twelve calendar months.
- The dates in the second table are illustrations of the anchoring rule, not dates any membership holds.
